snippet.title: Nocturnals: Out Now on iOS & Google Play
snippet.description:
Nocturnals is finally available for iOS & Google Play store!

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/nocturnals/id6740011391
** NOTE: This app is not compatible with the iPad 7th Generation. **

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cowboytoadgames.nocturnals&pcampaignid=web_share

Follow our other accounts: https://cowboytoad.games

Join our discord:  https://discord.gg/akemuca3WA

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

NOTE: Recommended for devices with 4gb or more of RAM.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Follow the story of Ted as he navigates the abandoned town of Ruddleside amidst the post apocalypse, finding a solitary companion in Diego.

Your choices determine whether Diego will bond with Ted and help him continue his search for surviving communities, or whether the pair will face difficulties and challenges that put them at odds with each other whilst trying to escape the horrors within Ruddleside.
